action: Block the PR: 7 critical finding(s) without an approved exception. Fix in order: IAC-009 Drop privileged; grant the specific capability instead.; IAC-013 Bind a namespaced Role with the verbs the workload needs.; IAC-014 Move the value to a secrets manager reference and rotate it; the committed value is compromised.
rationale: Static analysis of 8 terraform resource(s) against the SKILL.md misconfiguration tables. Block conditions: critical finding without approved exception, secret in IaC, IAM wildcard, public bucket or public admin port. 7 blocker(s); compliance score 0/100 (critical -25, high -10, medium -4, low -1). Confidence factors: base 0.60 for parsed resources, resource attributes supplied (+0.15), secret scan result supplied (+0.10).
key_findings: terraform scan of acme/payments-infra: 8 resource(s) in 4 file(s), 14 finding(s) (7 critical, 5 high, 2 medium), compliance score 0/100, PR BLOCKED
IAC-009 critical k8s/payments-api.yaml:20 Deployment payments-api: privileged: true -> Drop privileged; grant the specific capability instead.
IAC-013 critical k8s/payments-api.yaml:88 ClusterRoleBinding payments-api-admin binds a ServiceAccount to cluster-admin -> Bind a namespaced Role with the verbs the workload needs.
IAC-014 critical modules/database/vars.tf:8 Secret in IaC: database_password -> Move the value to a secrets manager reference and rotate it; the committed value is compromised.
IAC-006 critical modules/iam/roles.tf:5 IAM policy ci-deploy grants Action * on Resource * -> Scope actions and resources to the least privilege the workload needs.
IAC-008 critical modules/network/sg.tf:40 Security group bastion-ssh-any exposes SSH (22) to the internet -> Restrict the CIDR to the bastion or VPN range, or move to SSM Session Manager.
IAC-001 critical modules/storage/s3.tf:12 S3 bucket payments-exports has public ACL -> Set acl = "private" and enable the public access block on the bucket.

findings.title: Deployment payments-api: privileged: true
findings.remediation: Drop privileged; grant the specific capability instead.

findings.title: ClusterRoleBinding payments-api-admin binds a ServiceAccount to cluster-admin
findings.remediation: Bind a namespaced Role with the verbs the workload needs.

findings.title: Secret in IaC: database_password
findings.remediation: Move the value to a secrets manager reference and rotate it; the committed value is compromised.

findings.title: IAM policy ci-deploy grants Action * on Resource *
findings.remediation: Scope actions and resources to the least privilege the workload needs.

findings.title: Security group bastion-ssh-any exposes SSH (22) to the internet
findings.remediation: Restrict the CIDR to the bastion or VPN range, or move to SSM Session Manager.

findings.title: S3 bucket payments-exports has public ACL
findings.remediation: Set acl = "private" and enable the public access block on the bucket.

findings.title: S3 bucket payments-exports allows public ACLs
findings.remediation: Set every aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block flag to true.

findings.title: Deployment payments-api: runAsRoot: true
findings.remediation: Set runAsNonRoot: true and a fixed runAsUser.

findings.title: IAM role ops-breakglass can be assumed without MFA
S3 bucket payments-exports is not encrypted at rest
S3 bucket payments-exports has access logging disabled
findings.remediation: Enable server access logging to a dedicated log bucket.

findings.title: Deployment payments-api: automountServiceAccountToken: true
findings.remediation: Set automountServiceAccountToken: false unless the pod calls the API.

findings.title: S3 bucket payments-exports has versioning disabled
findings.remediation: Enable versioning; it is the ransomware and accidental-delete recovery path.

block_reason: IAC-009 Deployment payments-api: privileged: true; IAC-013 ClusterRoleBinding payments-api-admin binds a ServiceAccount to cluster-admin; IAC-014 Secret in IaC: database_password; +4 more
